summary: Frontend E2E testing of the new chat-first landing page + brief carry-over into Generator. All 6 scenarios from the review request pass (8/8 sub-tests). Guest chip flow with free-text vibe, skip buttons, start-over, logged-in full flow, login carry-over, and regression (empty Generator + normal login->/dashboard) all work as spec'd. sessionStorage 'sg_pending_brief' JSON is stored correctly (description, industry, business_name, brand_keywords, style) and consumed+cleared by Generator's useEffect. Industry is correctly empty for typed ideas (only chips set industry). Vibe chips map to correct keywords/style (Warm & cozy -> warm,cozy,welcoming/modern; Premium & elegant -> premium,elegant,refined/elegant). Did NOT trigger actual generation (LLM budget exhausted per main-agent note).
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx: `finishFlow` sets sessionStorage synchronously BEFORE the AI 'perfect' message shows, which is correct for navigation, but note that if a chip is clicked while typing indicator is active (e.g. right after name step), `typing` guard is not applied to vibe chips or `finishFlow(v, ...)` — only to skipStep and send. Not currently exploitable in tests but consider guarding vibe chip clicks with `typing` check as well.

Landing.jsx line ~137: when skipping vibe (`finishFlow(null, null)`), the final brief is still stored — good — but the AI's 'Perfect…' message uses `n = final.business_name` which may be undefined (if name was also skipped); the template literal produces `for undefined` guard: it uses `n ? ` for ${n}` : ''` — this is fine. No bug.

Login.jsx / Register.jsx: banner condition uses `sessionStorage.getItem('sg_pending_brief')` evaluated during render (not reactive). Works because you land on these pages with brief already stored, but if brief is cleared/added during the same mount, banner won't update. Non-blocking.
Login.jsx redirect: `navigate(sessionStorage.getItem('sg_pending_brief') ? '/generate' : '/dashboard')` — brief remains in sessionStorage until Generator's useEffect consumes it. Correct.
Generator.jsx useEffect: removes 'sg_pending_brief' before parsing — good (prevents stale brief on re-mount). JSON.parse is in try/catch. Solid.
AuthCallback.jsx not tested (Google OAuth) — skipped per instructions.
No a11y label on textarea (aria-label absent) — placeholder only. Minor accessibility improvement opportunity.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat-first landing feature is stable. sessionStorage key: 'sg_pending_brief'. Vibe chip mapping (index -> keywords/style): 0=warm,cozy,welcoming/modern; 1=premium,elegant,refined/elegant; 2=playful,bold,vibrant/playful; 3=clean,minimal,airy/minimal; 4=modern,sleek,innovative/modern; 5=classic,trustworthy,established/corporate. AI typing indicator ~750ms — use 1500ms waits between chat steps. Owner login without brief -> /dashboard; with brief -> /generate. Register applies same rule. Generation itself (clicking generate-btn) returns 500 due to LLM budget exhaustion per main-agent note — do not test.
